description: Montana DUI Reform Summit Brings Statewide Conversation to KalispellImpaired driving continues to take lives, devastate families and challenge communities across Montana. On Thursday, September 3, Representative Courtenay Sprunger will host the Montana DUI Reform Summit at Flathead Valley Community College to bring together the people working closest to the issue — and the community members whose voices should help shape future solutions.The free public event will run from 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.
